name: Inviting Someone to Eat
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on inviting someone to eat — practice these key phrases out loud:
Would you like to grab dinner sometime this week?
I know a great little place downtown.
Are you free for lunch tomorrow?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
